## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors.
- [ ] `dotnet build -c Release` succeeds.
- [ ] I tested the affected command(s) manually.
- [ ] I updated documentation, help text, and translations where needed.
- [ ] I added no tokens, passwords, personal paths, or other secrets.
- [ ] New dependencies were discussed in an issue first (if applicable).
